correctness.rationale: Radial angular orthogonality makes the Fock monomials e_n=z^n/sqrt(n!) exact complete eigenvectors with lambda_n=(∫_0^u+∫_a^b)e^{−t}t^n/n!dt. For all t in the observation set, t<=3 implies strict lambda_{n+1}<lambda_n for n>=2 because annulus has positive measure. The exact pointwise polynomial 3t²−8t+2>=0 on [0,s−] union [s+,3] implies lambda1 < (lambda0)/4+3lambda2/4, ruling out degree1, including at crossing. The difference lambda0−lambda2=H(u)−H(a)+H(b); H is strictly increasing on [0,s−] and decreasing on [s+,3]. The rational endpoint bounds in RESULT Step4 give H(s−)>95/512>5/32>H(a)−H(b), yielding unique interior u* for every parameter pair. At tie exactly span{1,z²} maximizes. For one radial interval [A,B], integration by parts gives sign(lambda_n−lambda_{n+1}) of e^{−B}B^{n+1}−e^{−A}A^{n+1}, allowing at most one adjacent tie. Independent high-precision quadrature/root solves for a=5/2,b=13/5 and a=s+,b=3 agree with complete ordering; analytic inequalities, not finite numerics, ensure all n.
